purpose: Teach: 嘆く/本性/有様/人道的/勇敢/執念/スクープ/高学年

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の不正、本気で、絶対、市民が、絶対、嘆く、絶対、声、絶対、当社、絶対、真摯に、絶対、受け止めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Industry misconduct is serious — I need our company to face these citizen concerns with real integrity.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Clean attack on opening word. Each clause distinct and deliberate. No rush. The tone of someone who has thought about this and means every word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織の本性、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、誇れる、絶対、ものに、絶対、してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're committed to making this organization something our staff can actually be proud of.
lines.style: Formal but genuine. Slight lean forward on commitment. Even pace, no backtracking. The deference of someone who heard the weight in what was said.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の有様、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、変えていくぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want to keep pushing for real change in how our industry operates.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Direct eye contact implied. Not a question — a statement of intent. Slight emphasis on 'keep.' The voice of someone doubling down.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、人道的、絶対、取り組み、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our humanitarian initiatives are moving forward. The team's working hard on that.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Respectful pace. Not rushing to fill silence. The tone of someone reporting progress without overstating it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 勇敢な、本気で、絶対、決断、絶対、当社、絶対、続けてきた、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The courageous decisions we've made as a company have set us apart.
lines.style: Controlled and precise. Weight on 'courageous.' Slight pause after 'company' — letting the thought land. The voice of someone proud but not performing pride.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の執念、本気で、絶対、業績向上、絶対、つながっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our staff's dedication is what's driving our performance forward. That's what makes the difference.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Even rhythm. The 'yes' is automatic but genuine. Speaking from something observed and felt, not just reported.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の新事業、本気で、絶対、各紙の、絶対、スクープ、絶対、扱い、絶対、対応せよ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our new business initiative — handle the media coverage carefully and professionally.
lines.style: Direct command wrapped in composure. Sharp attack. Each noun gets distinct emphasis. The tone of someone used to being listened to and expecting follow-through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の高学年児童、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、教育支援、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're providing educational support to students in the local community. That's part of our commitment.
lines.style: Deliberate close. Slight warmth on 'educational support.' Even pacing, grounded. The voice winding down with something meaningful — not just ticking a box.
